label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter 1, cold)
summary: Full cold codegen of the sranger package (8 files) from system_description.txt + requirement_all.json. 3 issues flagged: terminal-mode rename (design_choice), HALTED tick self-loop (design_choice), Move-as-operation encoding (design_choice).

issues.title: Terminal mode named HALTED instead of Final
issues.raw: SR-DM1/SR-FR3 name the terminal mode 'Final'. CLAUDE.md ('Interpreting Isabelle Results') states the theory-generated controller must NOT contain a Final state — it leaves the deadlock_free proof unprovable and the closing tactic hangs. SRanger is single-controller, so its controller IS the theory-generated one.
issues.fix_directive: If the pipeline accepts it, no change needed. If reviewers require the literal name 'Final', the Isabelle theory generator must first learn to designate terminal states (wf_rcstore-style invariant).

issues.title: HALTED given a tick self-loop not present in the requirements
issues.raw: SR-Beh1..7 define no transition out of the terminal mode. An absorbing state with no outgoing transitions deadlocks the CSP model and breaks the Isabelle deadlock_free proof (every state needs a bare-precondition operation). A Tick-triggered self-loop (pattern (b) from CLAUDE.md) keeps HALTED live without changing observable behaviour.
issues.fix_directive: Accept as the standard terminal-mode encoding, or remove if FDR4/Isabelle are reconfigured to designate terminal states.

issues.title: Move(lv, av) encoded as a two-argument operation call, not an output event record
issues.raw: SR-DM4 describes a single output event Move(lv : real, av : real). RoboChart events carry one payload; the M2M's documented encoding for multi-arg outputs is an LOperations Call (java2robochart.etl operationSigLookup). Actuator.move(lv, av) is therefore invoked directly in transition actions instead of constructing an OutputEvent record.
issues.fix_directive: Accept: the formal model gets move(p0 : real, p1 : real) in LOperations. If a true output *event* is required, the payloads would have to be split into two single-payload events, which deviates further from SR-DM4.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> ... -> vacuity) and iterate from post_* feedback.
